titleCard.title: GECKO JUSTICE
titleCard.subtitle: SEWER OF THE NINJA
titleCard.houseRulesText: HOUSE RULES: NINJAS COME OUT OF ANYTHING ROUND. THROW THEM AT THE SCREEN. IT IS ALLOWED HERE.
titleCard.announcerLine: GAME 1 OF 999. THE REPTILES ARE WAITING YOU.
titleCard.announcerLineCorrected: GAME 1 OF 999. THE REPTILES ARE WAITING FOR YOU.

deadweightDave.line: A SEWER? THEY PUT ME FIRST IN A SEWER?

dirkHeadline.line: DIRK HEADLINE, LIVE FROM A PIPE. THE NINJAS ARE WEARING SHOES ON THEIR HEADS. MORE AT ELEVEN.
UPDATE: THE FAMILY IS SURFING. WE HAVE NO FOLLOW-UP QUESTIONS.

outro.lickspittle: THE GECKOS CAN KEEP THEIR SEWER. I AM KEEPING THE BABY! CARTRIDGE SWAP!
outro.announcer: THE GECKOS SAY THANK YOU. IN THE NEXT CARTRIDGE.

parodyMeta.bootlegOf: a sewer stage full of ninjas
parodyMeta.gag: The family helps four geckos get their sewer back
tells: The title card says (TM?) instead of a trademark
The sewer water scrolls the wrong way in the background
